henry.title: Harvest Dance Rhythms
henry.intro: Harvest festivals have music with strong beats. A rhythm is a pattern of sounds and quiet spaces.
steps: Compose a 'harvest dance' in Song Maker.
worksheet: Write your rhythm with X for a beat and - for quiet (8 boxes).
What did changing the tempo do?
Describe your harvest dance in 3 words.
Draw a picture of a fall festival with music.
links: Tap the dots to make the monkeys drum, then press ▶.
Click squares to add notes for your harvest dance, then press ▶.

frankie.title: Falling Leaves Song
frankie.intro: Fall leaves are red, orange, and yellow. Let's draw leaves and hear them sing!
steps: Draw leaves in Kandinsky and press play.
worksheet: Clap: leaf, leaf, fall-ing! How many claps? ___
links: Draw leaves with your finger, then tap ▶ to hear them sing!
